entry.title: Church of the Holy Sepulchre

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM770.4363m at anchor. Estimated0.75m church/court floor, range foundations and terrace levels are exterior approximations against coarse sloping ground.

entry.note: Exact-QID outline/current main and part polygons, mapped dome/bell height intervals and south entrance court establish approximate scale and signed facing. Untagged levels and terrain/terrace joins remain estimates. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
